title: Africa's land area vs. US + China + India + Japan combined (million km²)
notes: Combined land area of the United States (~9.83M km²), China (~9.60M km²), India (~3.29M km²) and Japan (~0.38M km²) is about 23.1 million km², smaller than Africa's ~30.4 million km² — the basis of the widely circulated 'True Size of Africa' comparison.
